concerns.text: Task T015 logic states: 'If a source lacks the quality_rating column entirely, exclude the entire source and log...'. This contradicts the spec's FR-001 and US-1 which mandate downloading BOTH Persona-Chat and EmpatheticDialogues. The task introduces a silent relaxation where the pipeline proceeds with a single dataset if one fails, violating the 'both datasets' constraint of the spec.

Task T032a enforces a 'FAIL' state if LIWC-2015 acquisition fails, explicitly logging 'FR-005 NOT SATISFIED'. This violates the spec's FR-005 which requires the system to 're-run the analysis... and compare'. The task creates an unresolvable block (pipeline abort) rather than implementing the robustness check, effectively weakening the requirement to a hard dependency on a proprietary resource not guaranteed to be available.

Task T027a implements a fallback to 'fixed-effects ordinal regression' if CLMM convergence fails. The spec's Edge Cases only authorize a 'simplified model (remove random effects)' and FR-003 mandates a 'Cumulative Link Mixed-Effects Model'. Switching to a fixed-effects model (which is not a mixed-effects model) constitutes a semantic weakening of the core statistical requirement (FR-003) unless the spec explicitly allows model class substitution.

Task T019 mandates 'global standardization' (z-scoring across the entire merged dataset) for mean_politeness_score. The spec FR-002 requires computing a mean and standardizing, but does not explicitly mandate global merging before standardization. If datasets have different distributions, global z-scoring distorts the metric relative to the original contexts, potentially violating the 'structured format' preservation implied in FR-001 and the validity of the politeness metric.

Task T040 sets a memory limit of 7GB and raises an error if exceeded. The spec SC-002 and Plan.md Constraints state the limit is 'Peak usage ≤ 6 GB' (to fit within 7GB runner with overhead). The task relaxes the constraint from 6GB to 7GB, risking OOM on the target runner and violating the performance constraint defined in the plan.
